name: Kakan no Renkinjutsushi ~Harukaze no Fuku Machi~
original_name: 花冠の錬金術師～春風の吹く街～
source:
Once upon a time there was a beautiful kingdom surrounded by mountains called the Country of Garland.
Until now, the flower crown country had no exchanges with other countries, but two years ago, it began to accept travelers little by little. But some neighbors are rowdy. Therefore, King Adonis decided to build a new checkpoint town. At the center of the project was the alchemist Lily, a friend of King Adonis. Her goal is to turn the checkpoint town built on barren land into a prosperous town by using the mysterious items she creates. Lily welcomed her heartily and headed for the checkpoint street with her disciple Tesla.
translation:
从前，有一个群山环绕的美丽王国，名叫“花冠之国”。
此前，花冠之国与其他国家一直毫无往来，但从两年前起，它开始一点点接纳外来的旅人。然而周边也有一些不守规矩的邻国，于是国王阿多尼斯决定新建一座关口城镇。而处于这一计划核心的，正是国王阿多尼斯的友人——炼金术师莉莉。她的目标是运用自己炼制出的不可思议的道具，将这片荒芜土地上建起的关口城镇打造成繁荣的街市。莉莉欣然接下重任，带着弟子特斯拉一同前往关口街道。
